column1: # This board has a 16MB flash chip (esptool flash_id: "Detected flash size:
# 16MB"). The 2MB layout in git history was a config choice
#   bootloader 32K + partition table 4K + nvs 24K + phy 4K = 80K fixed
#   app (factory)    2048K  (the circular keyboard's widened font + code
#                            pushed the app past the old 1392K ceiling; the
#                            16MB chip leaves plenty -- consumers find every
#                            64K leaves headroom for SPIFFS garbage collection)
